title: Full Stop
style: Deep house with new age textures; sparse glass bells lead over warm sub bass, steady four-on-the-floor kick, and slow uneasy choir pads at 122 BPM. High, light male and female leads argue in close-miked overlapping verses, with stacked harmonies on a simple descending chorus melody. Strip the beat for the final exchange; cut all sound on the last word.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Low Pad, Single Glass Bell]

[male:]
Why shouldn’t I kill him?

[female:]
Because you shouldn’t.

[male:]
That’s what I’m asking.
Why?

[Verse 1]
[female:]
Call it the law. Call it a sin.
I don’t know which you’ll hear.
You keep asking for a reason.
I’m trying to give you one.

[male:]
A stone will fall out of my hand
Whether I believe it will.
A law we write is something else.
Whose voice am I supposed to hear?

[Pre-Chorus]
[female:]
Mine, for a minute.
Let me finish what I mean.
I have to live here with you.
You have to live here with me.

[Chorus]
[female:]
If you can do it just because,
What keeps the rest of us alive?
If you can do it for the fun,
Do I get to decide the same?

[male:]
I’m asking you about one man.

[female:]
I’m asking how we live together.

[Instrumental Drop]
[Glass Bell Motif, Low Choir Pad]

[Verse 2]
[male:]
You take a question about him
And make it one about us all.
I tell you what I’m thinking now.
You tell me what I’d let you do.

[female:]
If killing is a way out
Every time you’ve had enough,
What happens when it’s someone else
Who’s had enough of you?

[Final Chorus]
[female:]
If you can do it just because,
What keeps the rest of us alive?
If you can do it for the fun,
Do I get to decide the same?

[male:]
I’m asking you about one man.

[female:]
I’m asking how we live together.

[Outro]
[Spoken Dialogue, Kick Drops Out]

[male:]
You’re generalizing. And—

[female:]
Full stop. That’s it.

[male:]
I—

[female:]
Enough.

[male:]
But—

[female:]
Enough.

[Hard Cut]
